column1: # Word classes for the semantically unpredictable pt sentences (FR-COR-04). Every word is a word of the Leipzig list
# por_news_2022_10K (checked by tests/host/test_corpus_pt.py), chosen by hand among its frequent content words and
# classed by this project. Columns: class, word, then gender (nouns: m|f) or the feminine form (adjectives).
# Classes: noun, adj, verb_t (takes an object; past, 3rd person), verb_i (takes a preposition), prep.
